data.title: Christmas Scavenger Hunt Clues, 24 Rhymes & Riddles (Digital Download)
data.description:
Turn Christmas morning into a treasure hunt: kids follow clue cards from the tree to the fridge to the sock drawer until they find their gift. Every one of the 24 hiding spots comes in two levels, so little ones and big kids can hunt together.

What's inside (13 pages):
- How the Hunt Works page with setup steps and a sample 6-spot hunt
- Setup Sheet and Answer Key: all 24 spots with codes and an order column
- Little Elves Clues: 24 easy rhyming cards for early readers (about ages 4 to 7)
- Big Kid Riddles: 24 riddle cards for older kids (about ages 8 to 12)
- 6 blank Write Your Own Clue cards for spots only your home has
- 6 Final Gift cards to write where the present is waiting

Spots include the Christmas tree, stockings, refrigerator, couch cushions, bookshelf, a coat pocket, the bathtub and more. Use 6 spots for toddlers or all 24 for a long morning.

How it works:
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing ships. After purchase, download the file from your Etsy Purchases page or the email Etsy sends you, then print at home on cardstock and cut along the dashed lines. Prints on US Letter and fits A4 with "fit to page". For personal use.

This design was created with AI assistance under the creative direction of the seller.
